title: Updates
description: New versions are verified by signature and only installed while the app is idle.

info.autoOn: Automatic installation while idle is on.

available.title: Version {{version}} available
available.none: You are running the latest version.

confirm.installMessage: Tapesmith restarts briefly and then opens with the new version in a new browser tab.
confirm.rollbackMessage: Tapesmith restarts briefly and then opens with the previous version in a new browser tab.
confirm.downgradeMessage: Tapesmith backs up your data first. Settings and data written by a newer version may not be fully understood by an older one. Tapesmith never goes back to an older version on its own. Tapesmith restarts briefly and then opens in a new browser tab.

versions.label: Specific version
versions.help: All published versions, newer and older. Each one is signature checked before it is installed.
versions.downgradeHint: Older version: a backup is made first.
versions.failedHint: This version already failed here and will not be installed again.
versions.sourceError: Could not load the version list from the source, showing local versions only

notInstalled: Development build or not installed: updates are only available in the installed app. Install it with: py -m tapesmith install
runningFromSource: Running from the source folder: this copy does not update itself. Start the installed version for updates (tools\installed-start.cmd).
